Let Tset={positive t:q*t in factorCarrier(S)}. Let Fset be the signed nonzero integers with |f|<=F0. Choose nonnegative finitely supported majorants psiB(b),psiC(c), at least1 on the actual [B0,4B0],[C0,8C0] integer boxes, independent of f,zeta,t,h. Smooth choices are allowed but no smoothness is needed for the finite lemma.

For fixed f,b,c and fixed g,d1,D,d, choose r0|b/A, w0|c, and rprime|D*w0. These determine n2=b/(A*r0), n1=c/w0, r=d*r0, sprime=D*w0/rprime, N1=A*n1,N2=g*n2. Because f!=0, p=(d1*n1-n2)/(D*f) is unique if it exists. Original support/congruence/prime/factor constraints only reduce this count. Therefore multiplicity<=tau(b/A)tau(c)tau(D*c)<=tau(b)tau(c)^2tau(D).

Since p>=Q,r>=R,w>=RS, mesh_o<=L_D. The function x->x/(1+xH) is increasing for x>=0,H>=0, so w_o<=W_D with no extra constant or power. Group the positive squares by zeta,f,b,c, pay M, and enlarge outer boxes using psiB psiC>=1. This is where outside support is enlarged, with its explicit nontrivial Fset and box costs.

Expand P_zeta only AFTER that positive extension. Split the literal unsigned-slope equivalence classes to get R_zeta>=0. For the complement, modular units give h/(b*t)-h2/(b*t2)=k/(b*z) modulo c, and h/(zeta*t)-h2/(zeta*t2)=k/(zeta*z) modulo A. Multiplicativity of the additive character yields the displayed factors.
